reserveReview.rationale: 100% denotes the complete disclosed strategy envelope, not measured XAUt or USDT net weights. XGLD Accountable dashboard reopened 2026-10-03 reports gross reserves USD 12,500,048.65: Binance USD 11,885,621.03 and BNB USD 614,427.62, against token-supply valuation USD 11,268,230.83 (ratio 1.109318). Its surplus is gross assets minus token liabilities, not debt-netted NAV. Binance is a reported venue, not proof of direct exchange possession because docs describe OES mirroring. Terms identify Unipay Labs Limited as platform operator under Singapore law but explicitly cover USDu/sUSDu, not an XGLD issuing entity.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: At the 2026-10-03 dashboard observation Binance represents about 95.1% of gross venue reserves, with the remainder on BNB; this is concentration evidence, not a legal-custodian or net-backing share. Program OES docs name Copper/Ceffu, segregated MPC cold storage and approximately hourly rebalancing in USDu context, but do not bind those providers or protections to XGLD. Exact Fund Vault addresses, XGLD legal custody/continuity, borrowed liabilities and net weights remain unverified.
